cma.guard: Amazon Europe Core SARL has signed undertakings committing to enhance its existing systems for tackling fake reviews and ‘catalogue abuse’.
cma.summary: Amazon Europe Core SARL signed undertakings (signed 8 May 2025, accepted 6 June 2025) to enhance systems for tackling fake reviews and catalogue abuse, with sanctions for sellers and users who post fake reviews.

cma.guard: The CMA published a non-confidential version of its decision to accept commitments from Amazon in relation to certain practices on its Marketplace platform in the UK.
